UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION

Washington, D.C. 20549

FORM 10-K

For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023

Item 1. Business

Apple designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories worldwide. The Company also sells a variety of related services, including AppleCare, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, Apple Arcade, and Apple Pay.

Apple was incorporated in California in January 1977. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods, HomePod, and a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications.

The Company sells its products worldwide through its retail and online stores, direct sales force, and third-party cellular network carriers, wholesalers, retailers, and resellers.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

The Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition, and stock price can be affected by a number of factors, whether currently known or unknown, including those described below.

Macroeconomic and Industry Risks: The Company’s operations and performance depend significantly on worldwide economic conditions. Uncertainty about, or a decline in, global or regional economic conditions can have a significant adverse effect on the Company’s business, results of operations, and financial condition, including in the following ways:

Demand for the Company’s products and services may decline significantly. Credit markets may contract, making it difficult for consumers and businesses to obtain financing to purchase the Company’s products.

Competition: The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive. The Company is confronted by aggressive competition in all areas of its business. The Company’s competitors include companies that design, manufacture, and market mobile phones, personal computers, tablets, and wearables.

Supply Chain Risks: The Company is exposed to risks associated with global supply chains. Disruptions in manufacturing, logistics, or the supply of components could adversely affect product availability and financial results. The Company relies on sole-source and limited-source suppliers for certain components and materials.

Item 2. Properties

The Company’s headquarters are located in Cupertino, California. As of September 30, 2023, the Company owned or leased approximately 33 million square feet of building space around the world.

Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes.

Total net sales for fiscal 2023 were $383.3 billion, compared to $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022, a decrease of $11.0 billion or 3%. iPhone net sales decreased 2% or $3.9 billion during fiscal 2023 compared to fiscal 2022.

Services net sales reached an all-time high of $85.2 billion during fiscal 2023, an increase of 9% or $6.9 billion compared to fiscal 2022, driven by growth across all lines of business.

The Company’s effective tax rate for fiscal 2023 was 14.7%, compared to 16.2% in fiscal 2022.

Capital expenditures were $10.7 billion during fiscal 2023, with future planned capital expenditures primarily related to the construction of new facilities and the purchase of equipment.

Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

The Company is exposed to market risk related to changes in interest rates and foreign currency exchange rates.
